description: This file defines the PingGrain class, a grain implementation for the Orleans distributed application framework. It implements the IPingGrain interface with methods for activation and ping-pong interleaving communication between grain instances.

classes.name: PingGrain
classes.description: A grain class implementing IPingGrain, providing ping-pong messaging functionality within Orleans.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Handles grain activation, referencing self as an IPingGrain.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: A placeholder method with no implementation, potentially for future use.

methods.name: PingPongInterleave
methods.description: Recursively calls the other grain's PingPongInterleave method to simulate ping-pong messaging for a specified count.
